sbe:messageSchema.description: seqeron frame layer: the application and system envelope pairs

composite.name: messageHeader
composite.description: Template and schema identification for every message on the wire

composite.name: unsequencedHeader
composite.description: Application frame header on cluster ingress: the producer, its connection and cluster session, and the payload's protocol

type.name: sourceId
type.description: The producer (§5). A gateway uses its gatewaySourceId. -1 is reserved for the cluster and illegal here (F-4)

type.name: connectionId
type.description: The producer's connection id; unique within one producer, not across producers

type.name: sessionId
type.description: Aeron Cluster session id; advisory. The sequencer overwrites it with the session the frame arrived on

type.name: payloadId
type.description: The payload's schema or encoding (§6). 0 is invalid and 1 is retired; both are rejected

composite.name: sequencedHeader
composite.description: Application frame header on the tap: the ingress header, plus globalSeqNo and timestamp

type.name: sourceId
type.description: Copied from ingress

type.name: connectionId
type.description: Copied from ingress

type.name: sessionId
type.description: The Aeron Cluster session id the frame arrived on

type.name: payloadId
type.description: Copied from ingress

type.name: globalSeqNo
type.description: Cluster-wide sequence number: 1 for the first frame, then +1 per emitted frame, with no gaps and no reuse (S-4)

type.name: timestamp
type.description: Raft consensus time at commit, in nanoseconds since the epoch; never a node's local clock (S-3)

composite.name: unsequencedSystemHeader
composite.description: System frame header on cluster ingress: the same 18 bytes, naming a system event instead of a payload protocol

type.name: sourceId
type.description: The producer (§5). -1 is reserved for the cluster and illegal here (F-4)

type.name: connectionId
type.description: The producer's connection id, or -1 for an event that concerns no connection

type.name: sessionId
type.description: Aeron Cluster session id; advisory. The sequencer overwrites it with the session the frame arrived on

type.name: systemEventType
type.description: The event in the payload; MUST be an allocated, ingress-legal value (§7)

composite.name: sequencedSystemHeader
composite.description: System frame header on the tap: the ingress header, plus globalSeqNo and timestamp. Also the header of the three synthesized templates

type.name: sourceId
type.description: Copied from ingress; -1 on a synthesized frame (F-4)

type.name: connectionId
type.description: Copied from ingress; -1 on a synthesized frame

type.name: sessionId
type.description: The Aeron Cluster session id the frame arrived on; -1 on a synthesized frame

type.name: systemEventType
type.description: Copied from ingress; on a synthesized frame, the value for that frame's template (§7)

type.name: globalSeqNo
type.description: Cluster-wide sequence number: 1 for the first frame, then +1 per emitted frame, with no gaps and no reuse (S-4)

type.name: timestamp
type.description: Raft consensus time at commit, in nanoseconds since the epoch; never a node's local clock (S-3)

type.name: correlationId
type.description: Set by clusterctl so it can recognise its own frame on the tap

type.name: gatewayName
type.description: Name an instance is launched with (e.g. SEQERON_*_GATEWAY_NAME), by which it finds its list row; byte 0 = 0x00 means absent

type.name: protocolName
type.description: Label SbeLogPrinter prints for a payload it cannot decode; byte 0 = 0x00 means absent

type.name: applicationName
type.description: The deployment's name for a co-located application; byte 0 = 0x00 means absent

sbe:message.name: Unsequenced
sbe:message.description: An application frame on cluster ingress. The sequencer either republishes it as Sequenced or rejects it and emits nothing (§9.2)

data.name: payload
data.description: The payload, opaque to the cluster and copied unchanged to the tap. At most MAX_PAYLOAD_LENGTH bytes (§12); MAY be empty

sbe:message.name: Sequenced
sbe:message.description: An application frame on the tap: a sequenced ingress frame, payload unchanged

data.name: payload
data.description: The payload, byte-identical to the ingress frame's

sbe:message.name: UnsequencedSystem
sbe:message.description: A system frame on cluster ingress. Only the nine submitted events are legal here

data.name: body
data.description: The event named by header.systemEventType, as its SBE block with no MessageHeader. Empty when the event has no fields

sbe:message.name: SequencedSystem
sbe:message.description: A submitted system frame on the tap: a sequenced ingress frame, payload unchanged

data.name: body
data.description: The event, byte-identical to the ingress frame's payload

sbe:message.name: ClusterHeartbeat
sbe:message.description: The cluster clock, synthesized once a second from a cluster timer. No payload: the frame's timestamp and globalSeqNo are the message (42 bytes)

sbe:message.name: LeadershipChanged
sbe:message.description: A new leadership term began. One per term, including a term the same member wins again

field.name: newLeaderMemberId
field.description: Aeron Cluster member that leads from this globalSeqNo on

field.name: leadershipTermId
field.description: Aeron Cluster leadershipTermId of the term that starts here

sbe:message.name: GatewayActive
sbe:message.description: Designates one gateway instance as active. Synthesized on bootstrap, session close, activation timeout and GatewayActivationRequested (§7.2)

sbe:message.name: ConnectionOpened
sbe:message.description: A producer opened a connection. connectionData is the connection's identity in the producer's own encoding, opaque to the cluster tier; MAY be empty (§7.1)

sbe:message.name: ConnectionClosed
sbe:message.description: A producer's connection closed. No fields: header.connectionId identifies it

sbe:message.name: ClusterStarted
sbe:message.description: Operator marker: the cluster is up. Published by clusterctl once a leader is elected

sbe:message.name: ClusterStopped
sbe:message.description: Operator marker: an orderly shutdown has begun. Published by clusterctl shutdown

sbe:message.name: GatewayRegistered
sbe:message.description: One gateway list row, published by clusterctl load-topology. After the row with remaining = 0 the sequencer synthesizes the bootstrap GatewayActive frames

field.name: remaining
field.description: Gateway rows still to come after this one; 0 on the last

field.name: gatewayId
field.description: The row's identity, unique in the list; what GatewayActive names

field.name: gatewaySourceId
field.description: The logical gateway this row belongs to, shared by all its instances; compared with header.sourceId (S-6)

field.name: preferenceRank
field.description: 0 = designated primary (exactly one per gatewaySourceId); 1, 2, … = standbys

sbe:message.name: GatewayStarted
sbe:message.description: A gateway instance started. Binds its cluster session to gatewayId and releases every connection still open under its gatewaySourceId

field.name: firstConnectionId
field.description: First connectionId this instance allocates, above the highest it saw during replay

sbe:message.name: PayloadIdRegistered
sbe:message.description: One protocols row from the topology file: the name of a shared payloadId. Labelling only; the sequencer does not decode it and it admits nothing (C-2)

field.name: protocolVersion
field.description: Revision the deployment runs; printed, never checked

sbe:message.name: GatewayActivationRequested
sbe:message.description: An operator asked for a gateway instance to be made active (clusterctl activate). The sequencer validates it against the list and answers with a synthesized GatewayActive (§7.2)

sbe:message.name: ApplicationRegistered
sbe:message.description: One co-located application from the topology file (§5). Applications are not elected, so the row has no instance id, rank or countdown. Labelling only; the sequencer does not decode it
